description:
.Net Developer - ONLY EAD or GC or USC - Must be LOCAL 

 Rosemont, IL 
 12 month contracts 
 

 Must be local to IL or come for an in person interview to IL at their own expense 
 
 * Healthcare or Call center experience will be a plus. 
 
 Original job description: 
 
 Responsibilities: 
 · Collaborate with engineers and business analysts, analyze/classify complex change requests and review/evaluate possible enhancements 
 · Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable and reliable code 
 · Ensure the best possible performance, quality and responsiveness of applications 
 · Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to mitigate and address these issues 
 · Help maintain code quality, organization and automation 
 · May mentor others on coding standards and perform code reviews 
 · May aid in integration activities with other IT departments for successful implementation and support of project effort 
 Requirements: 
 · BA/BS degree or technical institute training 
 · Minimum of 5 years applied experience using C# in .NET Framework 
 · Knowledge or experience in ASP.NET, MVC 3+, WCF, ADO.NET 
 · Strong understanding of HTML, JavaScript, JQuery, AJAX, XML and CSS 
 · Proficiency in SQL and T-SQL including database development and optimization/performance tuning 
 · Experience implementing automated testing platforms and unit tests 
 · A good understanding of Service Oriented Architecture and multi-tier applications 
 · Understanding of fundamental design principles for building a scalable application 
 · Excellent communication skills 
 
 Preferred Skills: 
 · Familiarity with AngularJS or similar JavaScript-based application frameworks 
 · Experience and knowledge of Health Care Industry desired 
 · Experience with contact center operations is helpful
